description: Select a DOM element by CSS selector so the apply_css_to_selected, execute_js_on_selected and get_selected_element tools have a target. Requires Chrome: call launch_chrome or connect_to_existing_chrome first. Note the two mutating tools differ in reach - apply_css_to_selected injects a stylesheet rule, so it affects EVERY element matching the selector, while execute_js_on_selected runs against the FIRST match only. A selector that does not match clears the selection rather than leaving the previous one in place.

selector.description: CSS selector for the element to select, e.g. "#submit" or ".row .qty".

name: select_element
